title: Amee store package metadata
description: store.json — everything the STORE needs that the skin itself doesn't. Deliberately disjoint from manifest.json: name, author, description, version and the window dimensions are read from the manifest and never re-typed here, so there is exactly one source of truth for each fact. This file is not shipped inside the .ybskin.

kind.description: Which registry this package belongs to. Only `skin` is open today; the field exists so extensions can be added without reshaping anything.

owner.description: GitHub login allowed to publish updates to this package. CI checks the PR author against it.

license.description: SPDX identifier, e.g. MIT. A LICENSE file in the package directory is encouraged but not required.

tags.description: Free-form filter chips on the store page. Keep them short and lowercase.

homepage.description: Where a curious user can read more — the skin's own repo, usually.

sdkVersion.description: The window.amee SDK contract this skin was written against (`amee.version`). Bumped only on a breaking SDK change.

minAmeeVersion.description: Oldest Amee release this skin works on. Shown on the store card, and enforced: Amee refuses to install a package that needs a newer build than the one running, before downloading it. Setting this higher than your skin really needs will block installs for users who would have been fine.

preview.description: Package-relative path to the store card image. Required — a store listing with no picture is not a listing.

screenshots.description: Extra images for the detail panel.

build.description: Present when the package is compiled from source rather than shipping a hand-written entry file. Its point is reviewability: CI runs the build so the repo can hold readable source instead of a committed bundle nobody can audit.

command.description: package.json script name to run. Not a shell string — it is passed as a single argv element to `<pm> run`.

output.description: Directory the build writes to, package-relative. Its contents plus manifest.json become the .ybskin.
